description: Ask a follow-up about the current screenshot question on the user's page (e.g. "another approach", "explain line 3"), same as typing a follow-up on the page; not possible while an answer is being written. Assessment follow-ups are billed by mode. Runs in the desktop assessment overlay when the user is in an assessment (it must have started); otherwise in screenshot solving on the live / mock interview page (the web page must be sharing the screen). Uses the user's minutes or credits or creates a payment; tell the user what it costs and get their agreement first. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope interviews:write.)
name: follow_up_screen_question
